_strategyNote: M:M associate a botcomponent with a connection reference via the botcomponent_connectionreference relationship. Required for connector-based components to function.

requiredFields.constraint: full URL to the connectionreferences row being associated

lastVerifiedBy: build-pipeline uses this to link tool components to connection references
knownQuirks: Must use PUT (not POST) to add an association to an M:M navigation property
The @odata.id value must be a full absolute URL, not just the GUID
Missing this association is bm-037: 'Dataverse MCS added via raw POST requires botcomponent_connectionreference M:M association' — documented learning

errorCases.reason: Either botcomponent or connectionreference GUID not found
